recordedBy: Michael J. Moore|Hilda Flores Olvera|Helga Ochoterena Booth|Norm Douglas
habitat: Along wash that leads from area of extensive gypsum hillsides. Many gypsum endemic growing along the wash including several (Mabrya erecta, Nerisyrenia, Nama stenophyllum, Sartwellia, Phacelia) that were no found growing on gypsum hillsides themselves. Conditions dry.
locality: On the W. side of the Sierra de Tlahualilo.
occurrenceRemarks: Collected for the project “Origin and Evolution of the Chihuahuan Desert Gypsum Endemic Flora”
name: Phacelia marshall-johnstonii var. deliciasana B.L.Turner
